create.name: Kriya Yoga Institute
create.bio:
The Kriya Yoga Institute in Homestead, south of Miami, is the ashram Paramahamsa Hariharananda set up in 1997 as the mother centre of his Kriya Yoga mission for the Americas, Australia and New Zealand. He had first come to Florida in 1974, and in his last years he made the five-acre property his home, planning its fruit groves, vegetable gardens and pond himself. Its meditation hall, built to his design, was opened by him in September 2002.

Today it is run under his successor, Paramahamsa Prajnanananda, and its monks lead the Kriya Yoga programmes held there through the year: weekend initiations for newcomers, retreats for the holy days and New Year, Easter and the anniversaries of the lineage, and intensive retreats for those already practising. On ordinary days the ashram keeps a fixed routine of silent meditation, study and seva, and initiated practitioners may ask to stay for up to two weeks in its dormitory rooms.

courses.title: Kriya Yoga Initiation Program, December 2026
courses.description: A two-day weekend at the Homestead ashram: an initiation ceremony on the Saturday morning, then technique classes, guided meditation and a question-and-answer session, with online registration required and a minimum age of 13.

courses.title: Shri Gurudev's Mahasamadhi Commemoration
courses.description: Three days marking the anniversary of Paramahamsa Hariharananda's passing, with silent meditation, guided Kriya sessions, talks on video and seva; meditation sessions and rooms are for initiated practitioners.

courses.title: Holy Days and New Year Retreat
courses.description: A nine-day holiday retreat over Christmas and New Year with satsang, sadhana and seva; the fee is a voluntary donation, and guided meditations and lodging are for initiated practitioners.

courses.title: 2nd Kriya Intensive Retreat
courses.description: A four-day intensive led by Swamis Atmavidyananda, Chidrupananda and Vairagyananda Giri for those deepening their Kriya practice.

courses.title: Easter Retreat
courses.description: An Easter weekend retreat at the ashram led by Swami Tapasyananda Giri.

courses.title: Ashram stay at the Mother Center
courses.description: Dormitory stays of up to two weeks for initiated practitioners who come for practice, prayer, study and service, at 40 US dollars a day including meals, requested through an online form.
